budget.recharge.01.story: Your phone recharge runs out today. The shop near the bus stop has the basic ₹199 plan, and a pair of shiny earphones on offer for ₹599.
lesson.needs_first: Needs come first: pay for what you must have before what you would like to have.
lesson.wants_cost: Every want has a cost: ₹599 on earphones is ₹599 less for your goal.
persona.sana.name: Sana
persona.sana.bio: Sana, 18, teaches tuition after college and is the first in her family heading to a degree.
persona.ravi.name: Ravi
persona.ravi.bio: Ravi, 17, helps at his father's tiffin stall in the Old City. Sales go up and down.
budget.recharge.01.b.later: The cheap earphones broke. A new pair costs ₹150.
budget.bus_pass.01.story: A new month starts. The monthly bus pass costs ₹400. Daily autos are ₹25 a trip, about ₹500 a month.
budget.bus_pass.01.a.label: Buy the monthly pass
budget.bus_pass.01.a.lesson: Paying for the month up front can cost less than paying bit by bit.
budget.bus_pass.01.b.label: Pay for autos each day
budget.bus_pass.01.b.lesson: Small daily costs add up. Plan big regular costs at the start of the month.
budget.bus_pass.01.b.later: Auto fares this week added up to ₹350.
safe.otp.01.story: A caller says he is from your bank and needs the OTP sent to your phone to 'stop a block' on your account.
safe.otp.01.a.label: Hang up, share nothing
safe.otp.01.a.lesson: No real bank asks for your OTP. An OTP is like a key: never share it.
safe.otp.01.b.label: Read out the OTP
safe.otp.01.b.lesson: Sharing an OTP lets someone take your money. Report fraud on 1930.
safe.loan_app.01.story: Friends are going to a concert. Tickets are ₹2,000. An app offers an 'instant loan, no questions'.
safe.loan_app.01.a.label: Take the instant loan
safe.loan_app.01.a.lesson: Instant loan apps can charge high fees. A loan must be paid back, with extra.
safe.loan_app.01.a.later: The loan app wants its first payment: ₹1,200, of which ₹200 is fees.
safe.loan_app.01.b.label: Go to a cheaper show
safe.loan_app.01.b.lesson: You can still have fun while spending only what you have.
safe.loan_app.01.c.label: Skip it this time
safe.loan_app.01.c.lesson: Saying no today keeps your money free for your goal.
event.screen_crack.01.story: Your phone slips and the screen cracks. Repair costs ₹800.
event.screen_crack.01.a.label: Pay from savings
event.screen_crack.01.a.lesson: This is what an emergency fund is for: surprises that cannot wait.
event.screen_crack.01.b.label: Use a cheap screen guard for now
event.screen_crack.01.b.lesson: A cheaper fix can buy time, but plan for the real repair.
event.bonus_tuition.01.story: A parent is happy with your teaching and pays a ₹500 bonus.
event.bonus_tuition.01.lesson: Extra money is a chance to save before you spend.
reflect.general.01.q: What will you do differently next month?
reflect.stay_safe.01.q: Someone asks for your OTP. What do you do?
reflect.stay_safe.01.o1: Never share it and call 1930 if money is lost
reflect.stay_safe.01.o2: Share it only if they sound official
scam.why.urgency: Pressure to act right now is a warning sign.
scam.why.link: Unknown links can steal your details.
scam.kyc_link.01.s1: Your account will be BLOCKED today.
scam.kyc_link.01.why: Real banks never ask you to update KYC through a link in an SMS.
safe.exam_fee.01.s1: Exam fee is due on 15th. Pay at the college counter and collect a receipt.
safe.exam_fee.01.why: No link, no OTP, and you pay in person with a receipt.
quiz.budget.needs.a.q: Which of these is a need?
quiz.budget.needs.a.why: A need is something you must have, like getting to college.
quiz.save.emergency.a.q: What is an emergency fund for?
quiz.save.emergency.a.why: An emergency fund covers costs you did not plan for.
quiz.invest.compound.a.q: ₹500 a month grows more over time because…
quiz.invest.compound.a.why: Compounding: what your money earns can earn more too. Real results can be higher or lower.
quiz.invest.risk.a.q: Something that might grow fast can also…
quiz.invest.risk.a.why: Higher possible growth usually comes with higher risk.
quiz.safe.otp.a.q: Who should you share your OTP with?
quiz.safe.otp.a.why: Never share an OTP, not even with someone who says they are from a bank.
quiz.budget.needs.b.q: Which of these is a want?
quiz.budget.needs.b.why: A want is nice to have but you can live without it.
quiz.save.emergency.b.q: Your bike tyre bursts. What helps most?
quiz.save.emergency.b.why: Money kept for emergencies means a surprise does not become debt.
quiz.invest.compound.b.q: Starting to save early helps because…
quiz.invest.compound.b.o3: Growth has more time to build
quiz.invest.compound.b.why: Time lets growth build on growth. Real results can be higher or lower.
quiz.invest.risk.b.q: Putting all your money in one 'hot tip' is…
quiz.invest.risk.b.why: Spreading money out lowers the chance of losing a lot at once.
quiz.safe.otp.b.q: A message says you won a prize and asks for your OTP. You…
quiz.safe.otp.b.o2: Ignore it and never share the OTP
quiz.safe.otp.b.o3: Ask a friend to send it
quiz.safe.otp.b.why: Prize messages asking for an OTP are scams.
safe.loan_app.01.a.later2: Last loan payment: ₹1,200 again. Borrowing ₹2,000 cost you ₹2,400.
